decisions.decision: Scope the page to the session-selected vehicle (SuperchargerSessionsByVehicle), not account-wide
decisions.why: Consistency with the dashboard/history slices; per-car totals are meaningful. Rejected account-wide and account-wide+VIN-filter.

decisions.decision: Sessions with TeslaID == NULL are silently out of scope; recorded as a tested spec limitation, not disclosed on-page
decisions.why: Disclosure would need a second account-wide read on a read-heavy page for a set that is empty for single-car accounts.

decisions.decision: Three sections: StatTile KPI row, zero-JS SVG kWh-per-month bar chart, ui.Table of sessions
decisions.why: All from the existing ui/ kit and the proven HistoryChart pattern; no new primitive to invent. Top-sites section deferred.

decisions.decision: Cost aggregates group by currency and are never summed across currencies; nil cost/currency excluded from cost but counted in sessions/energy
decisions.why: TotalCost/Currency are per-session nullable and CountryCode proves cross-border charging; summing currencies is meaningless arithmetic.

decisions.decision: Month presets {3,6,12} default 6, validated by clampSuperchargerMonths; window filter applied in Go after the read
decisions.why: Mirrors historyDayPresets exactly (closed vocabulary); the port takes a row limit, not a time range. Sessions too sparse for day presets.

decisions.decision: const superchargerReadLimit = 500 rather than an unbounded limit=0 read
decisions.why: Mirrors history's LIMIT 400 safety cap; bounds a hot read path per the read-heavy performance profile.

decisions.decision: Tiles are Sessions/Energy/Cost/Avg-kWh-per-session; table renders every session in the window, unpaginated
decisions.why: Window plus read cap already bound the row count, and tiles/chart/table derive from one filtered slice so their counts cannot diverge.

decisions.decision: Granted the worker cmd/web/main.go as an explicit extra path beyond the module sandbox
decisions.why: The DI wiring is one field with zero business logic; splitting it out to the leader would fragment a 4-line change across two agents.

decisions.decision: Split wave 2 into templates (D) first, then handler logic (C), instead of one combined C+D wave
decisions.why: C.5's handlers render pages.SuperchargerStatsPage (D.5), so C-first leaves a non-compiling tree; D depends only on B, so templates-first keeps every wave green. Also keeps each dispatch ~6 tasks rather than 12.

decisions.decision: Accepted multi-line cost rendering via newline-joined CostLines + whitespace-pre-line, rather than extending ui.StatTile with a children slot
decisions.why: Keeps the shared ui/ component signature stable and the template math-free; changing a kit primitive is a wider design call than this change authorizes. Flagged for reviewer scrutiny as the weakest of wave 2's calls.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's chart zero-fill (one bar per month in the window, including months with no sessions) and its split number formatting
decisions.why: Zero-fill matches design.md's literal 'one bar per month in the window' and avoids a compressed timeline. Formatting follows two precedents: design.md examples for tiles, charges.go for table rows — leaving cost grouped in the tile but ungrouped in the table. Flagged for reviewer as a cosmetic inconsistency.

decisions.decision: Appended task G.1 (document Deps.SuperchargerReader in internal/gateway/AGENTS.md) — not present in the original tasks.md
decisions.why: Group A changed the gateway's public surface (gateway.Deps gained a port), and CLAUDE.md requires a module's public-surface change to be documented in the same change. Caught at the wave-4 boundary rather than in review. Append-only: no existing task was edited.
